## Introduction

For this assignment, I will be creating a HTML and JSON file with 3 books including multiple attributes. The following books will be manual entered into the file formats:

**Abstract Algebra**

- **Author**: David S. Dummit and Richard M. Foote

- **ISBN:** 9780471433347

- **Copyright Year:** 2004

- **Publisher:** John Wiley & Sons, Incorporated

**Normal People**

- **Author:** Sally Rooney

- **ISBN:** 9781984822185

- **Copyright Year:** 2018

- **Publisher:** Crown / Hogarth

**Frankenstein**

- **Author:** Mary Shelley

- **ISBN:** NA

- **Copyright Year:** 1818

- **Publisher:** Lackington, Hughes, Harding, Mavor & Jones

## Approach

I first plan to create the HTML and JSON files in VS Code, and then load the data into R. I would expect that dataframes will be the same when loading from HTML and JSON. I have experience working with HTML and JSON files in R, but I have never created them manually. Creating the files will be the most challenging part of the assignment, but I am exciting to learn something new.
